english: thus passes the glory of the world
also: so passes away the glory of the world

terms.comment: Traupman’s form is the one now quoted; we have found no ancient source for it. The Imitātiō Chrīstī has Ō quam cito trānsit glōria mundī!, “O how quickly the glory of the world passes!” (1.3.6).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Thomas à Kempis, De imitatione Christi 1.3.6, checked against the Latin Library texts (CLTK mirror) (12 November 2026).
